issue.title: Create Next App blank page on IE11 running next dev

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

issue.body:
### What version of Next.js are you using?

10.0.8

### What version of Node.js are you using?

14.15.4

### What browser are you using?

IE11 on Windows 10

### What operating system are you using?

macOS for development

### How are you deploying your application?

next dev

### Describe the Bug

Blank page in IE 11 with syntax error on `next dev`.

### Expected Behavior

The normal page view as in a current browser.

### To Reproduce

I used the Create Next app. No other dependencies. No code changes. 

Blank page in IE 11 with syntax error on `next dev`. See screenshot 01.png

At least with `next build && next start` I don't get an error message. See screenshot 01.png.
Only the layout bug that was already described in issue #21324.

![01](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1742089/110643890-d7d3a400-81b4-11eb-91d5-664617173d27.png)
Screenshot 01 after run `next dev`


![02](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1742089/110643900-d99d6780-81b4-11eb-95a3-d7740061e757.png)
Screenshot 02 after run `next build && next start`

body:
Seems like there are three issues: 
1) footer is too high - due to https://stackoverflow.com/questions/28627879/flexbox-not-filling-height-in-ie11, more or less fixed by adding `height: 100vh` to `.container`
2) cards don't fill width - due to https://stackoverflow.com/questions/29278121/flexbox-grid-ie-wraps-too-early, more or less fixed by replacing `flex-basis: 45%` with `width: 45%` in `.card`
3) "Powered By" gets wrapped - don't know what specifficaly, but applying any of `min-width: 200px`, `width: 100%`, `flex-grow: 1` to `.footer a` fixes it
@leerob Hey Lee, Can you assign this to me?
